name: social-video-transcript
title: Video Transcript & Translation: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram
description: Transcripts and SRT/VTT subtitles of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook and X videos, translated into Ukrainian and 20 other languages in the same run. Captions first, Whisper large-v3 when there are none. Failed videos are free. No API key.
